# Kayla Cortez

### Digital Marketing \| Marketing Analytics \| Museum Engagement Guide

I am currently a Digital Marketing graduate at Cal Poly Pomona with my background focused in engagement at museums, marketing analytics, and expanding outreach. I plan to use what I have learned from the Digital Marketing program and apply it to nonprofit organizations and reach future visitors who are curious and enjoy art.
